articles.title: Meloni: 'Con Trump non mi pento di nulla, punto all'unità dell'Occidente'
articles.summary: Meloni stated at the NATO summit in Ankara that she regrets nothing in her relationship with Trump and affirmed Italy's commitment to increase defense spending in a sustainable manner with national priorities.

articles.title: Meloni accelera sui dossier interni, vertice a Chigi sulla sicurezza
articles.summary: Meloni prioritized domestic policy issues by conducting a review of pending government objectives and convened a security meeting with her deputy premiers and ministers.

articles.title: Meloni, l'Europa difenda i propri confini con umanità ma anche intransigenza
articles.summary: Meloni voiced support for the EU's new sanctions regime against criminal networks exploiting migrant trafficking and stated that Europe should govern migration flows rather than be subject to them.

articles.title: Meloni, il futuro dell'Italia è delle donne lavoratrici, resta la priorità
articles.summary: At the UIL congress in Padua, Meloni stated that women workers are essential to Italy's future and highlighted achievements in female employment while calling for further progress.

articles.title: Meloni, 'Italia al top del turismo in Europa, grande lavoro del comparto'
articles.summary: Meloni praised Italy's continued position as a leading European tourism destination for summer 2026.
